mapper.select: SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM boards
SELECT * FROM boards order by regdate desc LIMIT #{offset}, 10
mapper.update: UPDATE boards SET subject=#{subject}, name=#{name}, email=#{email}, content=#{content} WHERE num=#{num}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boards (num, botype, group_num, name, subject, content, email, regdate) values (( SELECT MAX(num)+1 FROM boards as num ), 'notice', num, #{name}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{email}, now() )
